android.desc:
The Convoy app makes it easy for carriers to find, bid on, and haul loads from trusted brokers that keep their trucks full and earning on the lanes they like to run. With everything done quickly and easily through the Convoy app, you’ll spend less time chasing freight, and more time on what matters.


With the Convoy app, you can:


MAXIMIZE EARNINGS
• Find, bid on, and win loads 24/7—no phone calls required
• Get paid fast with Convoy QuickPay
• Request no-hassle detention or lumper payment codes within the app


REDUCE HASSLE
• Find and manage work right from your phone
• See broker, shipper and facility names and addresses on every load
• Upload documents to streamline bookkeeping
• Track your fleet’s locations and arrival times with GPS
• Get automatic alerts when loads are available on your preferred lanes


SEE ALL THE LOADS
• Sign up and book your first loads quickly - no matter the size of your business
• Get free access to thousands of nationwide loads from trusted brokers
• Book everything through the app and overcome the pitfalls of phone negotiations, like haggling, language barriers, and cultural biases


We operate in the contiguous 48 states.


Sign up through the Convoy app.

The Convoy Platform is owned and operated by Flexport Freight Tech LLC.

quotes.text:
Notably, a URL for the website is missing from the news article, as well as pretty much every single news article on Convoy.

But I found it, after furious Google sleuthing.

Their website:

https://convoy.com/

And their Android app:

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.convoy.driver&hl=en

The iOS app is Coming Soon(TM), and apparently they received $2.5M in seed funding yesterday.
quotes.story_title: Convoy presents itself as “Uber for trucking”
